about:
Each language is drawn as the countries or states/provinces where it is the main language (solid) or co-official, a lingua franca or a large minority language (lighter). Areas follow Natural Earth country and admin-1 borders, so they're a school-atlas simplification: real language borders don't follow provinces, and cities are mixed. Areas overlap where several languages are spoken. Speaker numbers are rounded estimates in the style of Ethnologue / Wikipedia (2025).

Language areas, numbers, phrases with pronunciation guides and facts were compiled with Claude; treat them as a learning aid, not a reference. The 🔊 buttons use your device's built-in speech voices, so they only work for languages your browser or phone has a voice for.
